name: Admin Document Edit
description: Edit an existing admin document, including its private notes. Entry from the Documents list carries the complete folder/filter/search/archive/view/page context into a validated `from` address; every editor exit returns there with a contextual label and restores the originating row/card, while native browser Back restores the same URL state. Direct or untrusted origins safely fall back to the Documents root. The compact doc-client-note-open entry opens a modal prefilled with email subject, email body, WhatsApp, and ordered custom title/content notes; applying changes participates in the unsaved guard, and save persists the complete collection. Failed or rejected saves retain the notes draft, while issued collection accounts expose it read-only. The existing content/status, client/project association, Markdown clipboard toolbar, template-style preview, and dual PDF download remain available.
